description_en: Queries a list of host accounts that the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is authorized to manage
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的主机账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-host-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --host-account-name root --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationHostAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host whose accounts you want to query.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html operation to query the host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. > We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_account_name
